show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/4VGEGE
show.description_secondary: When visionary executive Ravi Kashyap is betrayed by his corrupt CEO Nakul Mehta and abandoned by his wife Shanaya, his world collapses. But a chance encounter with delivery boy Chandra Gupta reignites his fire. Guided by the ancient wisdom of Chanakya Neeti, Ravi transforms himself into a modern day Chanakya building an empire from ashes to take ruthless revenge on those who destroyed him.
